title: 4 Major GTA 6 Questions the Previews Haven't Answered
description: Exploring the top four unanswered questions following Rockstar's Netflix GTA 6 extended look, featuring concerns over the cast and GTA Online.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## 4 Major GTA 6 Questions the Previews Haven't Answered

Following Rockstar Games' extended look at Grand Theft Auto 6 via Netflix, players and media outlets alike have been combing through every detail. However, according to an analysis by Polygon, this deeper dive has left the community with several major questions still up in the air.

### Who Is Actually in the Cast?

One of the most pressing mysteries surrounds the game's cast. While the trailers have given players a glimpse into the lives of the protagonists, the complete main cast and the actors behind the roles have not been fully detailed. The identities and backgrounds of the talent bringing these characters to life remain a talking point for fans.

### What Is Happening with GTA Online?

Another significant question mark is the future of GTA Online. Given the monumental success and long-term support of the online component in the previous title, players are eager to know how GTA Online will transition into the era of GTA 6. Rockstar's extended look left specifics about the online ecosystem largely unaddressed, leaving room for plenty of speculation.

### Waiting on Rockstar's Next Move

As anticipation builds for the game, the lack of definitive answers on these fronts highlights Rockstar's traditional marketing strategy of keeping details close to the chest. Until further official updates are provided, the community will continue to dissect every piece of media available.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar's choice to keep key details under wraps demonstrates a masterclass in building suspense. While waiting for answers regarding the cast and GTA Online can be frustrating, it ultimately fuels the immense hype surrounding GTA 6 as we inch closer to its release.
